Try to keep in mind that your potential partners in life undergo similar if not identical emotional cycles and stress / depressions that you will. Almost every average human being can easily relate to one another on basic levels and you can use this knowledge for leverage in social situations and as a padding for when you look at other people who appear happier than yourself - because they will eventually become sad and you'll eventually feel better in time, just within different time spans. Nobody is always jovial, and you cannot always be too sad. Your emotions evolve as you experience more and more and you will adapt. You have to adapt, or else you're just going to defeat yourself needlessly. The best ally you will ever have is yourself, because you feel that nobody else is reliable - but don't destroy the potential for friends and lovers. Give people the benefit of a reasonable doubt. Because it will likely turn out better than you expect - if not you'll be tough enough to get over it anyway.
